improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value prop (AI assistant for trade and business) and the free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audience trust. Including the three free searches CTA encourages clicks without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant) and who it serves (trade and business professionals). The subheading reinforces key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while creating a clear, low-friction call to action with the free trial offer. The name 'Gideon' is introduced naturally, building brand recognition without jargon.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own members workspace. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the user journey—the transition from free trial to paid membership. It sets clear expectations, reinforces value, and subtly promotes the annual discount, reducing abandonment at the paywall.
